## Highlights

Maintenance-and-tooling release on top of
[0.6.0](https://github.com/memblin/tkc-lvlab-py/releases/tag/0.6.0).
0.6.0 was the "stable + park" release; 0.7.0 keeps the parked runtime
behaviour intact while adding a maintainer validation layer and
clearing the dependency backlog that accumulated during the park.

- **Declarative CLI conformance harness (`scripts/validate/`).** A
    maintainer-only tool (dev-only, not shipped in the wheel) that drives
    the *installed* `lvlab` / `createvm` / `deletevm` binaries through a
    registry of scenarios across two lanes. The **cheap lane** needs no
    VMs and is safe to run anywhere — exit-code and stdout/stderr
    predicates covering the cross-binary CLI contracts (`--version`,
    help, the #147 error panels, the #149 no-manifest landing). The
    **stateful lane** provisions real prefixed `qemu:///system` guests
    and asserts the `createvm` matrix (DHCP / static / dual-stack /
    NAT-flag) reaches provision → running → DHCP-lease-resolves or
    static-IPv4-reachable.

    Safety mirrors the integration suite's `LVLAB_TEST_PREFIX`: every
    domain, disk, and ISO carries a session-unique
    `lvlab-validate-<epoch_ms>-<rand>-` prefix, and teardown only ever
    touches prefixed resources. The stateful lane prints current domains
    and requires confirmation (or `--yes`); a non-TTY without `--yes`
    runs the cheap lane only. Reports emit JSON plus a ready-to-paste
    issue body — never auto-filed. Run via `just validate`. See
    [`scripts/validate/README.md`](https://github.com/memblin/tkc-lvlab-py/blob/0.7.0/scripts/validate/README.md)
    for the lane breakdown and safety model.

- **`createvm` argument errors render again under Typer 0.27 (fix).**
    Typer 0.27 vendors Click as `typer._click`, and its error renderer
    only catches `typer._click.exceptions.ClickException`. The #147
    validation added in 0.6.0 raised `click.UsageError` from the
    top-level `click` package — a now-unrelated class hierarchy — so
    under Typer 0.27 both argument-shape errors escaped unrendered:
    **no message at all, and exit 1 instead of 2**. An operator typing
    `createvm web01` would have seen a silent failure.

    Both guards now use `ctx.fail()`, which raises from whichever
    hierarchy the Typer `Context` came from, so the fix is correct on
    old and new Typer alike. The `import click` that CLAUDE.md already
    forbids in these standalone scripts is gone. Rendered output is
    byte-identical to 0.6.0's boxed `╭─ Error ─╮` panel. This
    supersedes the "raises `click.UsageError`" implementation detail
    described in the 0.6.0 notes.

- **Dependency refresh, including one security advisory.** `uv.lock`
    regenerated with `uv lock --upgrade`: `typer` 0.25.1 → 0.27.2,
    `click` 8.4.1 → 8.5.0, `pytest` 9.0.3 → 9.1.1, `black` 26.3.1 →
    26.5.1, `pylint` 4.0.5 → 4.0.8, `pycdlib` 1.16.0 → 1.20.0, `tqdm`
    4.67.3 → 4.70.1, `zensical` 0.0.43 → 0.0.62, `pysonar` 1.5.0 →
    1.8.0. The zensical bump also resolves the Dependabot advisory on
    `pymdown-extensions` 10.21.3 (pulled in transitively) to 11.0.2,
    above the ≥11.0.1 the advisory requires. `pip-audit` reports no
    known vulnerabilities across the resolved tree.

    The `black` pin moved in **both** places that must agree —
    `pyproject.toml` and the `rev:` in `.pre-commit-config.yaml`.
    Dependabot registers only the `uv` and `github-actions` ecosystems,
    so it cannot see the pre-commit hook; taking its PR alone would have
    desynced `uv run black` from the hook that gates commits.

- **GitHub Actions majors.** `actions/checkout` v6 → v7,
    `actions/setup-python` v6 → v7, `actions/configure-pages` v5 → v6,
    `actions/deploy-pages` v4 → v5, `actions/upload-pages-artifact`
    v3 → v5. Four are Node-runtime/ESM bumps with no interface change.
    `upload-pages-artifact` needed checking — v4.0.0 stopped including
    hidden files (dotfiles) in the artifact, and v3 → v5 crosses that
    boundary. Verified inapplicable here: `zensical build -s` emits zero
    dotfiles under `./site`, and the artifact-upload deploy path does not
    run Jekyll, so no `.nojekyll` is needed. If the docs build ever starts
    emitting dotfiles, v5 exposes an `include-hidden-files` input.

- **SonarQube code smells cleared (no behavior change).** Duplicated
    literals extracted to constants (`DEFAULT_LVLAB_BASEDIR`,
    `FAILED_LIST_DOMAINS_MSG` / `FAILED_QUERY_STATE_MSG`,
    `_STYLE_PLAN_VALUE`); nested gateway/DNS/search ternaries in
    `createvm` replaced with a `_net_default()` helper; cognitive
    complexity reduced by extracting `_apply_interface_defaults` /
    `_validate_interfaces` / `_merge_shared_directories` from
    `Machine.__init__` and `_echo_protected_survivors` from
    `images_clean`. Remaining findings are accepted with rationale in
    the project's custom quality profile.

## Breaking changes

None. No runtime behaviour changes for manifests or the one-off
scripts — a manifest that worked on 0.6.0 works unchanged on 0.7.0. The
`createvm` change restores 0.6.0's intended error output rather than
altering it, and the dependency floors in `pyproject.toml` are
unchanged (`typer>=0.12` still holds, because `ctx.fail()` is valid on
every supported Typer/Click version).

## Install / upgrade

```bash
uv tool install --upgrade \
  https://github.com/memblin/tkc-lvlab-py/releases/download/0.7.0/tkc_lvlab-0.7.0-py3-none-any.whl
```

## Supported hosts

Unchanged from 0.6.0 — Debian 12 (3.11), Debian 13 (3.13), AlmaLinux 10
(3.12), Fedora 44 (3.14). See
[`docs-extra/host-validation.md`](https://github.com/memblin/tkc-lvlab-py/blob/0.7.0/docs-extra/host-validation.md)
for the matrix.
